look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Check opposite simple leaves with several strong veins arching toward the tip. Feel the conspicuously rough upper leaf surface and inspect hairs beneath; when fruiting, look for clusters of white drupes carried on reddish stalks. The staged fruit photograph shows white fruit and reddish pedicels, not the diagnostic leaf hairs.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Deciduous, often colony-forming multi-stemmed shrub or small tree; suckering growth can create thickets.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Leaves opposite, simple and usually ovate to elliptic with mostly entire margins; upper surface notably rough to touch, underside pubescent; several prominent lateral veins curve toward the tip.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Numerous small, four-parted whitish flowers in broad, flat-topped terminal clusters; confirm flower structure with a close-up.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Clusters of rounded whitish drupes, often on pink-red to reddish pedicels; photograph documents this character, not a leaf close-up.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Opposite leaf scars and branch arrangement; inspect young twig hairs and bark when leaves are absent.
